units.source_text: 次日，源氏写信给玉鬘，其中有言：“昨日你拜见了陛下么？

en.t: The next day, Genji wrote to Tamakazura, saying in the letter, "Did you have an audience with His Majesty yesterday?

units.source_text: 入宫之事，想必已经同意？”

en.t: As for entering the palace, surely you have already agreed?"

units.source_text: 写在白色纸上，措词很恳切，并无色情之谈，玉鬘看了甚为满意。

en.t: It was written on white paper, in very earnest words, with no flirtatious talk, and Tamakazura was quite pleased when she read it.

units.source_text: 她笑着说：“呀！多么无聊啊！”

en.t: She laughed and said, "Oh! How dull!"

units.source_text: 但她心中想道：“他真会猜量我的心情呢。”

en.t: But in her heart she thought, "He truly knows how to read my feelings."
